name: combined immunodeficiency due to OX40 deficiency
description: Combined immunodeficiency due to OX40 deficiency is a rare combined T and B cell immunodeficiency characterized by susceptibility to develop an aggressive, childhood-onset, disseminated, cutaneous and systemic Kaposi sarcoma.
